headline.en: Balde is staying. He is not first choice at left-back
headline.es: Balde se queda. No es titular en el lateral zurdo

summary.en: Alejandro Balde will remain at Barcelona until 2028 after being left out of the Elche squad and after Flick discussed him in public. La Vanguardia reported that he asked for minutes. Joao Cancelo and Xavi Espart are the players currently being used on the left.
summary.es: Balde seguira en el Barca hasta 2028. La Vanguardia conto que pidio minutos. Cancelo y Espart son los que estan jugando a la izquierda.

body.en:
Alejandro Balde has told Barcelona he is staying. His contract already runs to 2028. The week that led there was public. Flick left him out of the Elche match, spoke about him in a press conference and again on television, then sat down with him privately. La Vanguardia reported that Balde asked for minutes so he can put himself back in the side.

Joao Cancelo is now registered. Xavi Espart has been promoted to the first team and has already started. English clubs have been linked with Balde. No bid has been confirmed. Rayo Vallecano visit on Monday, which is the next time Flick has to name a left-back. Balde staying at the club does not, on its own, put him back in the eleven.

headline.en: Cancelo is registered after leaving Al Hilal on a free
headline.es: Cancelo esta inscrito despues de salir libre del Al Hilal

summary.en: Joao Cancelo is on the Liga list after terminating his contract with Al Hilal. Culemania grouped him with Anthony Gordon, Karim Adeyemi and Rodri as the four summer arrivals already registered under the 1:1 rule.
summary.es: Cancelo ya esta en la lista de Liga. Culemania lo agrupa con Gordon, Adeyemi y Rodri como los cuatro fichajes inscritos.

body.en:
Joao Cancelo's registration was delayed by the paperwork that ended his contract at Al Hilal. That work is done. He can now be named in a Liga squad. Culemania listed him with Gordon, Adeyemi and Rodri as the four summer signings already on the sheet.

Cancelo can play left-back and can also step into midfield, which is how Flick used him late against Athletic. Xavi Espart started that role at Elche. Alejandro Balde is in the squad and has not started. Registration only settles the legal question. It does not settle who plays against Rayo on Monday.

headline.en: Gordon started against Athletic, played 80 minutes, and did not score
headline.es: Gordon fue titular ante el Athletic, jugo 80 minutos y no marco

summary.en: Anthony Gordon made his first Barcelona start against Athletic Club and played 80 minutes. SPORT and Goal logged three recoveries, five duels won from nine, three dribbles and two shots. He did not score or assist. Adeyemi, who had started at Elche, replaced him late.
summary.es: Gordon hizo su primer once ante el Athletic y jugo 80 minutos. Tres recuperaciones, cinco duelos, tres regates y dos tiros. Sin gol ni asistencia. Adeyemi, titular en Elche, le relevo.

body.en:
Anthony Gordon made his first start for Barcelona against Athletic Club and stayed on for 80 minutes. He finished the night without a goal or an assist. SPORT and Goal published the same basic sheet: three recoveries, five duels won from nine, three completed dribbles and two shots. Karim Adeyemi, who had started the Liga opener at Elche, came on for the last part of the match.

Gordon left Newcastle for 70 million euros plus add-ons. Flick signed him as a winger who could press high and carry the ball. Adeyemi can occupy the same left-sided position. Rayo Vallecano visit Camp Nou on Monday, and Flick has not said which of the two starts. One home game against Athletic is the first set of numbers on Gordon in a Barcelona shirt. It is not a verdict on the fee.
